statement: A per-invocation value (varies run-to-run for identical input, e.g. a CI run-attempt number) must never be embedded in a hashed/reproducible artifact -- it belongs only in an accompanying envelope. Incident: cejel PR #282 (Track A5, github.run_attempt) placed the field correctly (attestation.json predicate only, never report.json) but shipped with no test proving it -- only tests written alongside the change, which encode whichever behavior shipped rather than verify it. Required: (1) a test scanning one revision twice with a differing value, asserting the hashed artifact is byte-identical while the envelope differs, and (2) demonstrating that test fail loud by temporarily moving the field into the hashed content, pasting the exact failure, then reverting before commit. A green suite does not settle a byte-comparability claim without a demonstrated failure against the wrong placement. Fix: BargLabs/cejel PR #282, squash-merged as 7319043 (carries both the placement and the proof test).

anchors.summary: Track A5 rider: github.run_attempt placed only in attestation.json's predicate, never report.json; squash-merge carries both that placement and the two-run byte-comparison proof test added on handback.
